title: the Relationship Between Cleft Lip and / or Palate (Different Types) and ABO Blood Groups.
brief_summary: Direct benefit of the research to assess the relationship between cleft lip and / or palate (different types) and ABO blood groups.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Egyptian Patients with cleft or/and palate
* The children's age ranged between 2 days and 15 years.

Exclusion Criteria:

* syndromic patients
study_population: 376 Egyptian cleft lip and/or palate patients (Age ranged from 2 days to 15 years ) With no syndrome .
